subjects.description: A flat, painted plywood deer silhouette mounted on a wooden stake, a static lawn decoy in the profile shape of a standing deer with slender legs and antlers

subjects.relationship: A decoy placed near the deer-crossing sign; visually mimics a live deer but is inert and never moves
subjects.location: right verge, mid-ground moving toward foreground
subjects.orientation: facing left, profile turned toward the road
subjects.pose: static standing profile, legs planted, head slightly forward
subjects.action: remaining completely motionless as the car passes

subjects.description: A yellow diamond-shaped deer-crossing warning sign on a metal post beside the plywood decoy
subjects.appearance_details: Standard reflective yellow diamond with a black leaping deer pictogram, mounted on a galvanized metal pole at the road edge
subjects.relationship: Official roadside signage paired with the decoy, warning of potential deer crossings
subjects.location: right verge, slightly behind and above the decoy
subjects.action: static roadside sign passed by the vehicle

background_setting: A quiet two-lane rural road stretching straight ahead through gently rolling countryside, bordered on both sides by mature deciduous and coniferous trees casting dappled shadows onto the asphalt. Grassy green verges line the shoulders, a faint yellow center line divides the lanes, and the road surface is dry and clear of any vehicles or animals. The sky is bright blue with only wisps of cloud, and the horizon opens onto more forested land.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows a clear two-lane rural road lined with sunlit trees, the yellow center line drawing the eye to the vanishing point. By 0:01 a flat brown plywood deer decoy on a stake and a yellow diamond deer-crossing sign become visible on the right verge. From 0:02 the vehicle continues at steady cruising speed, the decoy remaining perfectly still and clearly identified as a static object. At 0:03 the car reaches the roadside markers and, without slowing, glides past them. During 0:03 to 0:05 the decoy and sign slip past the right edge of the frame and disappear behind, while the road ahead remains open and empty, the vehicle carrying on smoothly.
